mapping.mapping_kind: Documented analytical crosswalk reconstructed from official source categories; not an official BC/SEMAS concordance
mapping.denominator: Sum of stores assigned to the eight mutually exclusive groups within each BC region; all-industry stores_total is displayed separately
notes: 한식 separates I20111 횟집 into 일식·회; all other listed Korean-food categories remain in 한식.
양식·카페 combines Western restaurants, pizza/burgers/sandwiches and cafés; I205 Southeast Asian restaurants are not silently included.
대형·슈퍼 includes other general retail G20499 as a broad proxy. It is not an exact one-to-one BC merchant taxonomy.
제과·떡 includes ice cream/bingsu in line with the supplementary BC grouping.
Each store contributes one count, not sales, floor area or capacity. A spending-share minus count-share gap is descriptive, not proof of unmet demand.
All unlisted source categories are excluded from the eight-group denominator and recorded in the coverage audit; they still contribute to stores_total.
The source has 16 province files, including a combined 전남광주 file. Its 27 source districts are explicitly crosswalked to the unchanged BC province/district keys; no proportional allocation is used.

Incheon reform is crosswalked to BC geography: 검단구+서해구 to old 서구, 영종구 to old 중구, 제물포구 split by the 18 explicitly listed administrative neighborhoods in the official Incheon reform table. No area/population proportional allocation.

No dedicated hypermarket code appears in the downloaded snapshot. The historical 대형·슈퍼 label is represented by G20404 supermarkets and G20499 other general retail; do not infer complete hypermarket coverage.
